content.value: Suppose there are 11000 students in any university admission test. Let the average score is 60 (in percentage) and standard deviation is 10. Also assume that scores are normally distributed. Find the expected number of students who are
(ii) Qualified but not eligible for choosing all departments (40 ≤ score < 80),
(iii) Qualified and also eligible for choosing any departments (score ≥ 80)
It is noted that the required probability of each case should be shown in figure.
